raster_source: CTX DEM 20 m; derived slope raster and prototype terrain cost raster, as described in project workflow

validation.note: No positive-area overlaps found; complete coverage of original intended study region not independently verified.

limitations: Zones are project-defined prototype regions, not official NASA hazard zones.
The GeoJSON coordinates are Mars projected meters, NOT Earth longitude/latitude. Do not load directly into Earth EPSG:4326 mapping libraries.
Slope and terrain cost statistics reflect zonal raster analysis, not a survival probability or NASA-certified safety rating.
Zone geometry was reconstructed; original extent and partition design should be reviewed by the team.
